author: salivan
text:
"Free Order Flow "

in order to read the market and understand every price movement in the
market we need to investigate the it in terms of true orders that
executed in the market .we know that FLs in the only true place in the
market that this sets of orders executed in . and also we know that this
 kind of orders executed after engulf of opposite orders .

so what we need again if we can see those orders ?

as i told before there are lots of FTRs in one TF but there are few FLs .
 but every of this FLs also has it's own value in terms of order flow ,
some are good for a bounce , some will be break with out any bounce and
some hold price .

how we can understand if those FLs have the orders to hold price or not ?

this is the most important question that we should ask every time we
look at the market .as we know ITs can not fill all their orders in one
place so they have to accumulation the orders to reach their targets .
but the places that they are going to start a new trend is FLs. in this
case they trade in monthly TF and start accumulation the orders in 1 min
 TF to their monthly target . so the targets are always important than
the entries , bcz if we understand the target we can understand also the
 whole story for price .

but what is FOF and what's it's rule in reading the market ?

Free Order Flow is the sets of orders that Clean and apply always in the
 market by pro moneys , they will create the scenarios by this to shake
out retailers and grab some more orders from unsuspected traders . as we
 know our target and entry are always FLs , so when they engulf a target
 in fact they are buying /selling in a higher/lower price so in it's
scale then are coming back to accumulation of orders and they want to be
 the only one that sell or buy in the market , but the question is this
how we can understand the ITs scenario in the price movement ?

this takes thousand of hours and full control in every scale to
understand what they are going to do next . as a basic we should
understand price reading article that is in the markepedia and also put
ITs hat in our head .

in order to understand this we should always ask this questions :

where price coming from ? a reached target or not ?determine your scale
that you want to trade . always look at HTF as it has the major map of
price movement and enter in lower TF as they create this map .

where is price now ? is it in S/D so it can fake to the extreme orders in to the true S/D .

and other parts in price reading article .

all my efforts here was to apply reading the market not drawing rectangles ,

if we want to understand FOF we should understand FLs scales,and
targets at first and we should understand big losses for ITs if they
don't take out some sets of orders , for example we want to trade daily
TF and we find a FL in daily TF to trade it , it's not guarantee that
they engulf a daily TF FL for showing us their intention for future ,
they can engulf a lower scale FL inside that daily FL but don't engulf
the daily FL , this is an other way for ITs to showing their intention ,
 that's why i always say try to read the orders .

look at the charts below :

so FOF has a big relationship with price reading article and targets for
 pro moneys . they always show their intention inside their targets .

how to be able to read FOF in the market :

if i want to write a proper way i can say without being able to read the
 market in terms of FLs and Orders and price reading article we can not
read FOF , and it's need massive focus to read it .

some clues :

basics :

1- understand the full concepts behind RTM stuff ( FTR,FL,QM,CP,CANCAN,CAPS,....)

PRO :

1-understand FL in terms of orders not rectangles .

2- understand scale and understand this , that orders are more important than the TFs .

3-understand this they need to left the targets for few pips around their higher scale targets for future .

4-what's CP ? it's a kind of deep RT after engulf . how a CP start to be play in price movment?

these whole pieces of puzzel can help you to understand FOF

understand price reading article as an Instinctive way .

more important than others , without putting thousands hours inside the
chart there is no way to understand it as it should be something
Instinctive.

hope it helps you .

regards

Salivan
